Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 34 Tempe Reserve

Clause 9.34.1 - heritage (environmental_protection): The precinct has been identified as having high biodiversity values. It is essential that development with the precinct considers the potential impacts to biodiversity including native fauna (including Threatened Species and Endangered Populations); native vegetation (including Endangered Ecological Communities); and habitat elements (including their condition, structure, function, connectivity and disturbance).

Clause 9.34.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.34.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.34.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.34.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.34.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect significant streetscapes and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.34.2 - other (environmental_protection): To ensure that new development considers all potential impacts to biodiversity.

Clause 9.34.2 - other (environmental_protection): To ensure that development in the foreshore area will not impact on natural foreshore processes or affect the significance and amenity of the area.
